blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Detectors of logical anomalies, such as missing, extra or wrongly combined parts, usually score a test image by its distance from normal (good) images. They achieve near-perfect image-level AUROC on standard industrial anomaly detection benchmarks such as MVTec LOCO, but their robustness to changes in capture conditions remains largely unexamined. Under a heterogeneous perturbation protocol in which each test image is randomly kept unaltered or subjected to a brightness reduction or a zoom-out transformation, the normal-reference methods we tested lose 9.7 to 34.1 AUROC points, and two of the strongest, CSAD and SALAD, fall from 97.7% and 96.4% to 68.1% and 62.3%. We propose a framework in which a classifier, trained on normal images and on synthetic anomalies, scores a test image without comparing it with normal data. From a short description of each product, a language model derives anomaly types and editing instructions, an image editor applies them to normal images, and the classifier learns to separate the edited images from automatically discovered normal sub-modes. With its full training recipe, the framework reaches 94.9% AUROC on clean images, 1.5 to 2.8 points below SALAD and CSAD, and 94.1% under the perturbation protocol. Trained without brightness or zoom-out augmentation, so that neither test perturbation occurs in training, it still reaches 92.5% (93.2% clean). These results suggest that clean benchmark scores can hide a strong sensitivity to capture conditions, and that learning the decision from both normal images and rule violations may reduce it.
blocks.zh: 逻辑异常的探测器,如缺失,额外或错误地组合的部分,通常会以与正常(好)图像相距相距而得分. 它们在MVTec LOCO等标准工业异常检测基准上实现了近完美图像级的AUROC,但是它们对于捕捉条件变化的强性基本上仍未被考察. 在一个千差万别的扰动协议中,每个测试图像被随机地保持不改变,或受到亮度降低或放大变换的影响,我们测试的正常参照方法损失了9.7至34.1AUROC分,两个最强的CSAD和SALAD从97.7%和96.4%下降到68.1%和62.3%。 我们提出一个框架,一个接受过正常图像和合成异常培训的分类员,在不与正常数据进行比较的情况下,对一个测试图像进行评分。 从对每种产品的简短描述中,一个语言模型得出异常类型和编辑指令,一个图像编辑器将其应用于普通图像,分类者学习将所编辑的图像与自动发现的普通子模型相分离. 有了完整的培训食谱,框架在清洁图像方面达到94.9%的AUROC,低于SALAD和CSAD的1.5至2.8分,在扰动协议下达到94.1%. 训练时没有亮度或放大增能,因此在训练时没有发生试验扰动,仍然达到92.5%(93.2%)。 这些结果表明,干净的基准分数可以隐藏对捕捉条件的强烈敏感性,从正常图像和违反规则行为中学习决定可能会减少.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Clean and heterogeneous AUROC. Five-category mean image-level logical AUROC on MVTec LOCO for clean test images and under the heterogeneous perturbation protocol, in which each test image is randomly kept unaltered or subjected to a brightness reduction or a zoom-out transformation. Our two variants are shown in blue: Ours (full recipe) and Ours (no overlap), which is trained without brightness or zoom-out augmentation and is therefore used to assess robustness. blocks.zh: 图1:清洁而多变的阿拉伯地球物理观测站。 五类是指MVTec LOCO上的图像级逻辑AUROC,用于清洁测试图像并置于多相扰动协议下,其中每个测试图像被随机地保持了无变化,或者受到亮度降低或放大变换. 我们的两个变体以蓝色显示: 我们的配方和我们的配方(无重叠),这些配方在训练时没有亮度,也没有放大,因此被用来评估稳健性。 AnomalyCLIP(低于虚线),一种不使用正常引用的零发法,甚至在干净的图像上也接近机会水平.

blocks.en: Visual anomaly detection is essential for automated quality control in manufacturing ( Lin et al., 2025 ) . Because defective products are rare and diverse, most detectors are trained exclusively on normal images, without access to real anomalies ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Bergmann et al., 2022 ) . We study logical anomalies, such as missing, extra or wrongly combined parts, rather than structural defects such as scratches. On MVTec LOCO ( Bergmann et al., 2022 ) , the standard benchmark for this task, the best methods, such as CSAD ( Hsieh and Lai, 2024 ) and SALAD ( Fučka et al., 2025 ) , reach near-perfect image-level area under the ROC curve (AUROC). Although both also train on synthetic anomalies, their score still depends on how far a test image lies from normal data; we call such methods normal-reference methods. These benchmark results, however, come from images taken under controlled capture conditions.
blocks.zh: 视觉异常探测对于制造业自动化质量控制至关重要(Lin等,2025年)。 由于有缺陷的产品是稀有而多样的,所以大多数探测器都是专门在正常图像上被训练出来的,无法接触真正的异常(Lin等,2025;Bergmann等,2022.). 我们研究逻辑异常,比如缺失,额外或错误地结合了部分,而不是抓痕等结构缺陷. 在MVTec LOCO(Bergmann等,2022年)上,这一任务的标准基准,最佳方法,如CSAD(Hsieh和Lai,2024年)和SALAD(Fučka等,2025年),可以到达ROC曲线下近乎完美的图像级别区域(AUROC). 虽然两者都对合成异常进行训练,但他们的分数仍然取决于测试图像与正常数据之间的距离;我们称之为正常参考方法. 然而,这些基准结果来自在控制捕获条件下拍摄的图像。

blocks.en: On a production line, illumination and camera position do not always remain constant ( Baitieva et al., 2025 ) . Robustness to such capture shifts has been benchmarked mainly for structural defects ( Cao et al., 2023 ; Pemula et al., 2025 ; Heckler-Kram et al., 2026 ) . We evaluate logical anomaly detectors on MVTec LOCO under a heterogeneous perturbation protocol (Section 3.6 ). Each test image is assigned at random to one of seven conditions, unperturbed or with a brightness reduction or a zoom-out at one of three strengths, and a single AUROC is computed over the mixed test set. Under this protocol, the normal-reference methods we tested lose 9.7 to 34.1 AUROC points, and CSAD and SALAD fall to 68.1% and 62.3% (Fig. 1 ). Since neither perturbation alters the logical content of an image, this drop originates in how the detectors score the perturbed images.
blocks.zh: 在生产线上,照明和相机位置并不总是不变(Baitieva等人,2025年)。 对这种捕捉转移的强度主要以结构缺陷为基准(Cao等人,2023年;Pemula等人,2025年;Heckler-Kram等人,2026年)。 我们根据各种扰动协议对MVTec LOCO上的逻辑异常探测器进行评估(第3.6节)。 每个测试图像随机分配到7个条件中的一个条件,未扰动或亮度降低,或以3个强项之一放大,在混合测试组上计算出一个AUROC。 根据这一协议,我们测试的正常参考方法损失了9.7至34.1 AUROC分,CSAD和SALAD为68.1%和62.3%(图1)。 由于扰动既不改变一幅图像的逻辑内容,因此这种下降源于探测器如何分出扰动图像.

blocks.en: A likely reason for this drop is that normal-reference detectors compare a test image with normal data taken under one lighting and one camera position. A darker image or a smaller object may then be scored as anomalous even when every part is correct; indeed, under both perturbations, many normal test images score above the median clean anomaly (Fig. 5 ). This reading suggests learning the decision instead as a contrast between normal images and rule violations seen under the same capture conditions, so that a capture change moves both sides alike. Our framework differs from CSAD and SALAD not in using synthetic anomalies but in this test-time decision, which is fully discriminative : the classifier scores a test image without comparing it with normal data. Learning this contrast, however, needs rule violations, and real ones are rarely available.
blocks.zh: 这种下降的一个可能原因是,正常参照探测器将一个测试图像与在一个照明和一个相机位置下取取取的正常数据进行比较. 更暗的图像或更小的物体,即使每个部分都正确,也可能被打成反常;事实上,在两次扰动下,许多正常的测试图像都得分高于中位净异常(图5). 这个读取建议学习这个决定,取而代之,作为正常图像与在相同的捕捉条件下看到的规则违规之间的对比,这样一个捕捉变化就同时移动双方. 我们的框架不同于CSAD和SALAD,不是在使用合成异常,而是在这个测试时间决定中,这是完全有区别的:分类者在不与正常数据进行比较的情况下对一个测试图像进行分分. 然而,要了解这种反差,就需要违反规则,而实际违反规则的情况很少发生。

blocks.en: Our framework therefore creates these rule violations as synthetic anomalies from a description of the product, so that, like the normal-reference methods, it needs no real anomaly during training. First, a person writes a short description of each category. From it, a language model proposes anomaly types, rule violations that could occur in the category, and writes an editing prompt for each; an image editor then applies one prompt to each normal training image. The edited images are then manually reviewed, assisted by a vision-language model, and only valid anomalies are retained. Normal sub-mode discovery, a simple automatic step, assigns each distinct group of normal images its own class, and the classifier is trained to distinguish these normal sub-modes from the anomaly types. Similar generate-then-train pipelines exist for structural defects ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Fučka et al., 2026a ; Hu et al., 2026 ) ; for logical anomalies, ComGEN ( Tong et al., 2025 ) generates anomalies with a diffusion model but keeps a normal-reference decision. In summary, our contributions are threefold: 1. We show that brightness reduction and zoom-out, applied at random to the test images of MVTec LOCO, reduce the AUROC of the normal-reference methods we tested by 9.7 to 34.1 points, a loss of 38.2% to 73.5% of their performance above chance (Section 3.6 ). 2. We propose a framework in which a classifier, trained on normal images and on synthetic anomalies derived from a short description of each category, scores a test image without comparing it with normal data. 3. With its full training recipe, the framework reaches 94.9% AUROC on clean images, 1.5 to 2.8 points below SALAD and CSAD, and 94.1% under the same perturbations; trained without brightness or zoom-out augmentation, it still reaches 92.5% (93.2% clean).
blocks.zh: 因此,我们的框架将违反规则的行为作为产品描述的合成异常,因此,与正常参考方法一样,在训练期间不需要真正的异常。 首先,一个人对每个类别作简短的描述。 从中,一个语言模型提出异常类型,可能发生在类别中的规则违反,并为每个类型写出编辑提示;然后一个图像编辑器对每个普通的训练图像应用一个提示. 然后在视觉语言模型的协助下对所编辑的图像进行人工审查,只保留有效的异常。 普通子模具发现,是一种简单的自动步骤,它指定了每个不同的普通图像组自己的类,分类器被训练来区分这些普通子模具和异常类型. 结构缺陷也存在类似的生成-当时的管线(Sun等人,2025;Fučka等人,2026a; Hu等, 2026 ; 对于逻辑异常, ComGEN(Tong等, 2025 ) 生成有扩散模型的异常, 但保留一个正常参考决定. 总之,我们的贡献有三: 1. 我们显示,在MVTec LOCO测试图像中随机应用的亮度降低和放大,将我们测试的正常参考方法的AUROC减少9.7至34.1分,其性能损失了38.2%至73.5%(第3.6节)。 2. 我们提出一个框架,根据这个框架,一个接受过正常图像和合成异常情况培训的分类员在对每个类别作简短描述后,在不与正常数据作比较的情况下对一个测试图像进行评分。 3. 框架通过全面培训配方,在清洁图像上达到94.9%的AUROC,在SALAD和CSAD下达到1.5至2.8分,在同样扰动下达到94.1%;在没有亮度或放大增能的情况下得到培训,仍然达到92.5%(93.2%)。

blocks.en: We show that brightness reduction and zoom-out, applied at random to the test images of MVTec LOCO, reduce the AUROC of the normal-reference methods we tested by 9.7 to 34.1 points, a loss of 38.2% to 73.5% of their performance above chance (Section 3.6 ).
blocks.zh: 我们显示,在MVTec LOCO的测试图像中随机应用的亮度降低和放大,将我们测试的正常参考方法的AUROC减少9.7至34.1分,其性能损失了38.2%至73.5%(第3.6节)。

blocks.en: We propose a framework in which a classifier, trained on normal images and on synthetic anomalies derived from a short description of each category, scores a test image without comparing it with normal data.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个框架,根据这个框架,一个分类员接受过关于正常图像和从对每个类别的简短描述中得出的合成异常情况的培训,在不与正常数据进行比较的情况下对一个测试图像进行评分。

blocks.en: With its full training recipe, the framework reaches 94.9% AUROC on clean images, 1.5 to 2.8 points below SALAD and CSAD, and 94.1% under the same perturbations; trained without brightness or zoom-out augmentation, it still reaches 92.5% (93.2% clean).
blocks.zh: 有了完整的培训配方,框架在清洁图像上达到94.9%的AUROC,在SALAD和CSAD下达到1.5至2.8分,在同样扰动下达到94.1%;在没有亮度或放大放大度的情况下得到培训,仍然达到92.5%(93.2%)。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Logical Anomaly Detection
blocks.zh: 2.1 逻辑异常检测

blocks.en: MVTec LOCO ( Bergmann et al., 2022 ) is the standard benchmark for logical anomalies, which break rules on the presence, number, position or combination of parts, unlike the local structural defects of MVTec AD ( Bergmann et al., 2019 ) . Because such a rule spans the whole image, the strongest methods model the image’s composition. CSAD ( Hsieh and Lai, 2024 ) segments components without manual labels and compares their patch histograms with those of normal images, and SALAD ( Fučka et al., 2025 ) adds a composition branch, trained on synthetic anomalies, to its appearance branches. PSAD ( Kim et al., 2024 ) learns part segmentation from a few labeled images, and SAM-LAD ( Peng et al., 2025 ) matches segmented objects with those of retrieved normal images. LogSAD ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) needs no training: it compares a test image with a memory of normal features and checks matching rules that its authors built from GPT-4V proposals, prompted with a few normal images and the benchmark’s constraint descriptions. By contrast, general-purpose detectors such as PatchCore ( Roth et al., 2022 ) model local normality and struggle with logical anomalies ( Kim et al., 2024 ) , and zero-shot detectors such as AnomalyCLIP ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) use no image of the target category. Apart from AnomalyCLIP, all methods above are normal-reference methods: they score a test image, at least in part, by its distance from normal training data. We examine this normal-reference design under capture shifts (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: MVTec LOCO(Bergmann等,2022年)是逻辑异常的标准基准,它打破了零件的存在,数量,位置或组合的规则,不同于MVTec AD的局部结构缺陷(Bergmann等,2019年). 因为这样的规则贯穿整个图像,所以最强的方法就是模拟图像的构成. CSAD (Hsieh and Lai, 2024) 片段组件没有手动标签,并将其补丁直方图与普通图像图相提并论,而SALAD(Fučka等,2025年)在其外观分支中增加了一个成分分支,经过合成异常方面的培训. PSAD(Kim等,2024年)从几个被标注的图像中学习出部分分解,而SAM-LAD(Peng等,2025年)则将分解对象与取回的正常图像相匹配. LogSAD(Zhang等,2025a)不需要训练:它将测试图像与正常特性的内存进行比较,并检查其作者从GPT-4V建议中构建的匹配规则,由一些正常图像和基准的制约描述所激发. 相形之下,PatchCore(Roth等,2022年)等通用探测器模拟局部常态并和逻辑异常相抗争(Kim等,2024年),AnomalyCLIP等零发取探测器. (周来等,2024)没有使用目标类别的图像. 除了AnomalyCLIP之外,上面所有的方法都是普通的参考方法:它们至少部分地通过它与正常的训练数据的距离来获得一个测试图像. 我们在捕捉移位下审查这种正常参考设计(第4节)。

blocks.en: Another line of work employs language models for detection. LogicAD ( Jin et al., 2025 ) describes images with text features from a vision-language model (VLM), and LogiCode ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) uses a large language model (LLM) to generate code that checks rules that experts extract from normal images. VLMs adapted to inspection ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Gu et al., 2024 ) detect and explain defects, and SCAN ( Li et al., 2026 ) fine-tunes a multimodal LLM to verify written inspection criteria rule by rule. In these methods, the language model participates in detection at test time or through the code it generates. In our framework, the language model contributes to generating the synthetic anomalies, which are used only in training, and the anomaly score is computed by the classifier alone.
blocks.zh: 另一行工作采用语言模型进行检测。 LogicAD (Jin等,2025年)描述了从视觉语言模型(VLM)中具有文本特征的图像,而LogiCode (Zhang等,2025年b)则使用大型语言模型(LLM)生成代码来检查专家从普通图像中提取的规则. 适应检查的VLM(徐等,2025;顾等,2024)发现并解释缺陷,SCAN(李等,2026)微调了多式LLM,以按规则验证书面检查标准. 在这些方法中,语言模型在测试时间或通过其生成的代码参与检测. 在我们的框架中,语言模型有助于产生合成的异常现象,这些现象只用于训练,异常分数由分类者单独计算出.

blocks.en: 2.2 Synthetic Data for Anomaly Detection
blocks.zh: 2.2 异常检测合成数据

blocks.en: Like many detectors, our classifier is trained on synthetic anomalies, which, for logical anomaly detection, must violate a rule of the category rather than merely alter local appearance. CutPaste ( Li et al., 2021 ) pastes image patches and DRAEM ( Zavrtanik et al., 2021 ) blends external textures into normal images; such local changes suit structural defects but rarely break a logical rule. For structural defects, generate-then-train pipelines exist, in which an LLM or a VLM describes defects and a generative model adds them to images: AnomalyAny ( Sun et al., 2025 ) guides Stable Diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) with a normal image, AnomalyVFM ( Fučka et al., 2026a ) inpaints defects into generated images to train a zero-shot detector, and MIRAGE ( Hu et al., 2026 ) edits normal images to train a segmentation network without real anomalies. None of these pipelines is designed for logical constraints.
blocks.zh: 和许多探测器一样,我们的分级器也接受过合成异常的训练,对于逻辑异常的探测,必须违反分类规则,而不只是改变局部外观. CutPaste (Li等, 2021) 粘贴图像补丁和 DRAEM (Zavrtanik等, 2021 ) 将外出纹理融合到正常图像中;这种局部变化适合结构缺陷,但很少违反逻辑规则. 对于结构缺陷,有生成-当时的列车管线,其中LLM或VLM描述缺陷,并有基因模型将它们添加到图像中: AnomalyAny(Sun等,2025年)以正常图像指导稳定分化(Rombach等,2022年),AnomalyVFM(Fučka等,2026a)将缺陷涂入生成的图像来训练零发探测器,而MIRAGE(Hu等,2026年)编辑了正常图像来训练分化网络,没有真正的异常. 这些管线都没有设计符合逻辑的限制.

blocks.en: For logical anomalies, synthesis without real anomalies has used hand-designed rules: CSAD pastes extra components into training images to train its segmentation, SALAD erases or inpaints components in composition maps, and LogicAL ( Zhao, 2024 ) edits edge maps. ComGEN ( Tong et al., 2025 ) instead learns a token for each component of an MVTec LOCO category with a diffusion model and removes tokens or samples unusual combinations to create anomalies; its detector compares each test image with the nearest normal image. All of these methods compare a test image with normal data at test time, directly or, in LogicAL, through a reconstruction of the image’s normal appearance. What sets our framework apart is therefore not the use of synthetic anomalies but its test-time decision. Table 1 compares these approaches with our framework.
blocks.zh: 对于逻辑异常,没有真实异常的合成使用了由手设计的规则: CSAD将额外的组件粘贴入训练图像来训练其分块,SALAD将组件去除或印入成份图中,LogicAL(赵,2024)会编辑边缘图. ComGEN(Tong等,2025年)取而代之的是,为MVTec LOCO类的每个组件学习一个有扩散模型的符号,并去除符号或样本异常组合来制造异常;其探测器将每个测试图像与最近的正常图像进行比较. 所有这些方法都通过对图像正常外观的重建,将测试图像与测试时间的正常数据直接地或者在逻辑中进行比较. 因此,把我们的框架分开的不是使用合成异常,而是它的试验时间决定。 表1将这些办法同我们的框架相比较。

blocks.en: Beyond anomaly detection, generated training data usually keeps its label: DGInStyle ( Jia et al., 2024 ) renders existing label maps in new styles, and ALIA ( Dunlap et al., 2023 ) edits training images along domain descriptions that an LLM summarizes from captions. Our edits instead change the label on purpose, turning a normal image into a specific rule violation, much as counterfactually augmented data ( Kaushik et al., 2020 ) revises text to fit a counterfactual label while avoiding unnecessary changes. Our image editor follows written instructions, like InstructPix2Pix ( Brooks et al., 2023 ) . Because each unedited image is also labeled normal, the classifier can learn the difference between normal and violation on the same scene and largely under the same capture conditions. Out-of-distribution detection also creates outliers without real ones, but not by editing a given image: Dream-OOD ( Du et al., 2023 ) decodes outliers sampled from low-likelihood regions of a latent space into images, and EOE ( Cao et al., 2024 ) has an LLM write the names of likely outlier classes.
blocks.zh: 除了异常检测,生成的训练数据通常保留其标签:DGInStyle(Jia等,2024年)使已存在的标记地图具有了新风格,而ALIA(Dunlap等,2023年)则会按照一个LLM从标题中总结的域名描述来编辑训练图像. 我们的编辑却故意更改标签, 将正常的图像变成违反规则的具体内容, 我们的图像编辑器遵循书面指令,如InstructPix2Pix(Brooks等,2023年). 由于每个未经编辑的图像也标出正常的标签,分类器可以在同一个场景中学习出正常和违反的区别,并且基本上在相同的捕获条件下学习. 分布外检测也会产生没有真实的输出,但不会通过编辑给定的图像: Dream-OOD(Du等,2023年)将从潜入空间的低象区所取取出的数据解码为图像,而EOE(Cao等,2024年)则有LLM写出可能的出数类的名称.

blocks.en: Table 1 : Synthetic anomalies in related methods and in our framework. Rows follow a synthetic anomaly from its source to the decision at test time. A normal-reference score depends, at least in part, on a comparison with normal training data. Our framework differs from the first column in the anomalies it targets and from the other two in its test-time decision. blocks.en: 2.3 Robustness in Anomaly Detection
blocks.zh: 2.3 异常检测的强度

blocks.en: Logical checks rest on counts, positions and proportions of parts; brightness reduction and zoom-out change how these appear: parts lose contrast against the background, or shrink and move. Yet robustness to capture shifts has been studied mainly for structural defects. Following corruption benchmarks for image classification ( Hendrycks and Dietterich, 2019 ) , Cao et al. (2023) corrupt MVTec AD test images, while AeBAD ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) , RAD ( Cheng et al., 2024 ) , RobustAD ( Pemula et al., 2025 ) and MVTec AD 2 ( Heckler-Kram et al., 2026 ) capture real changes of illumination, viewpoint or background. Moreover, detectors that are almost perfect on MVTec AD degrade on real production data ( Baitieva et al., 2025 ) . RobustAD also cautions that robustness to synthetic shifts may not carry over to real ones, and that training with the perturbations of a benchmark can leak its test distribution into training. We therefore make no claim about real capture shifts, and we report a variant of our framework trained without test-overlapping augmentations. We are not aware of a prior evaluation of MVTec LOCO logical anomaly detectors under capture shifts.
blocks.zh: 逻辑检查依赖于数、位置和零件比例;亮度降低和缩放变化这些部件的出现方式:部件与背景相对,或缩小和移动。 然而,主要针对结构缺陷,研究了捕捉变化的强度。 遵循图像分类的腐败基准(Hendrycks and Dietrich, 2019), Cao等 (2023) 腐败 MVTec AD 测试图像,而 AeBAD (Zhang等, 2023), RAD (Cheng等, 2024) , RobustAD (Pemula等,2025年)和MVTec AD 2 (Heckler-Kram等,2026年)捕捉出照明,观点或背景的真实变化. 此外,在MVTec AD上几乎完美的探测器在实际生产数据上降解(Baitieva等,2025年)。 强壮 反倾销局还警告说,稳健到合成转变可能不会延续到真正的转变,而带有基准扰动的培训会将其试验分布泄露到培训中去。 因此,我们不主张真正的捕捉转变,我们报告说,我们的框架有一个变体,没有经过试验重叠的增强。 我们不知道对捕获转移中的MVTec LOCO逻辑异常探测器事先进行过评估。

blocks.en: Test-time adaptation is an orthogonal route to robustness: Adapted-MoE ( Lei et al., 2025 ) uses the test images themselves to correct the shift between the features of training and test samples (Section 5.1 ).
blocks.zh: 测试时间适应是坚固性的正交道: 适应-MOE(Lei等,2025年)利用测试图像本身来纠正培训和测试样本特征之间的转变(第5.1节).

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出

blocks.en: The MVTec LOCO benchmark ( Bergmann et al., 2022 ) provides training and validation splits with only normal (good) images and a test split with normal images, logical anomalies and structural anomalies. We restrict the evaluation to the normal test images and the logical anomalies, which violate constraints on the presence, number, position or combination of parts, and report image-level AUROC. Our framework adds synthetic anomalies to the training and validation splits by editing their normal images. The classifier learns K K normal classes (Section 3.3 ) and N c N_{c} anomaly types (Section 3.2 ) and is selected on the validation split, so no real anomalous image is used for training or checkpoint selection. At test time, the classifier scores an image alone, without comparing it with normal data. We call this way of scoring a fully discriminative decision.
blocks.zh: MVTec LOCO基准(Bergmann等,2022年)提供训练和验证分解,只有普通(好)图像,测试分解与正常图像,逻辑异常和结构异常. 我们把评价限于正常的测试图像和逻辑异常,这违反了对零件的存在,数量,位置或组合的限制,并报告图像级的AUROC. 我们的框架通过编辑他们的正常图像,给训练和验证分裂增加了合成异常. 分类员学习了K K 正常班级(第3.3节)和N c N_{c}异常类型(第3.2节),并在验证分出时被选中,因此没有真实的反常图像用于训练或检查点选择. 在测试时间,分类器单独对一幅图像进行分数,而不与正常数据进行比较. 我们称之为这种完全歧视性的决定。

blocks.en: 3.2 Anomaly Design and Generation
blocks.zh: 3.2 异常设计和生成

blocks.en: The classifier needs examples of rule violations, but the training split holds only normal images, so we create such violations from a description of the product.
blocks.zh: 分类者需要违反规则的例子,但训练分拆只持有正常的图像,所以我们从产品描述中创造出这样的违反.

blocks.en: Category description. A person writes a free-text description of the normal images: which parts a correct product contains, how many, where they are and which rules relate them. For Pushpins, for example, each of the 15 compartments holds exactly one pushpin. Human knowledge of the product is a common input in logical anomaly detection: LogSAD ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) builds its matching rules from GPT-4V proposals prompted with the constraint descriptions of the MVTec LOCO paper, LogicQA ( Kwon et al., 2025 ) gives the same descriptions to a VLM to write checklist questions, LogicAD ( Jin et al., 2025 ) turns a written description of normality into logical formulas, LogiCode ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) turns rules that experts extract from normal images into code, and SCAN ( Li et al., 2026 ) checks written inspection criteria rule by rule. C.1 gives our descriptions in the structured form passed to the language model.
blocks.zh: 类别说明。 一个人对正常的图像写出自由文字描述:正确产品包含哪些部分,有多少部分,在哪里,哪些规则与之相关. 例如,对于Pushpins来说,15个车厢中的每个车厢都持有一个完全的推车. 人类对产品的了解是逻辑异常检测中常见的输入: LogSAD(Zhang等,2025年a)根据MVTec LOCO文件的制约性描述,根据GPT-4V建议,构建了匹配规则,LogicQA(Kwon等,2025年)给一个VLM来写清单问题,LogicAD(Jin等,2025年b)将关于常态的书面描述转化为逻辑公式,LogiCode(Zhang等,2025年b)将专家从正常图像中提取的规则转化为代码,SCAN(L等,2026年)按规则检查书面检查标准. C.1 以结构化的形式向我们提供语言模型的描述。

blocks.en: Anomaly types and editing prompts. From the category description and a fixed definition of a logical anomaly, the language model (GPT-5; OpenAI, 2025 ) proposes anomaly types, each a short statement of one rule violation, and writes one editing prompt per type. We set the number of types to N = 20 N=20 per category, which is within the range of prior work, from 10 defect types per category in MIRAGE ( Hu et al., 2026 ) to 50 logical-anomaly descriptions requested in LogSAD’s GPT-4V prompt ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . For Pushpins, type 6 is “One compartment contains two pushpins”, with the prompt “Add an extra pushpin to one compartment so it contains two pushpins” (Fig. 2 ). A person then checked the types and prompts. C gives all instructions, and C.2 all types and prompts.
blocks.zh: 异常类型和编辑提示 。 从分类描述和一个逻辑异常的固定定义来看,语言模型(GPT-5;OpenAI,2025)提出了异常类型,每个类型都有一个规则被违反的简短声明,并且每个类型写一个编辑提示. 我们设定类型数为N = 20 N = 20,每类属于先前的工作范围,从MIRAGE(Hu等,2026年)每类10个缺陷类型到LogSAD的GPT-4V 提示(Zhang等,2025年a)要求的50个逻辑异常描述. 对Pushpins来说,第6型是“一车厢包含两个推杆”,即“增加一个额外的推杆到一个车厢,使其包含两个推杆”(图2)。 然后有人检查了类型和提示。 C给出所有指令,而C.2给出所有类型和提示.

blocks.en: Image editing. The image editor, Gemini 3 Pro Image ( Google DeepMind, 2025 ) , applies one prompt to each normal image of the training and validation splits, and each resulting synthetic anomaly takes the anomaly type of its prompt as its label. Every normal image yields one synthetic anomaly, so N N sets only how the synthetic anomalies are divided among the types. Synthetic validation anomalies are made from validation images, so they share no source image with the training set.
blocks.zh: 图像编辑. 图像编辑器"双子座3 Pro Image"(Google DeepMind,2025年)对训练与验证分拆的每个正常图像应用了1个快取,每个结果的合成异常取其快取的异常类型作为其标签. 每个正常的图像都会产生一个合成异常,因此N N只设定了合成异常如何在类型之间划分. 合成验证异常来自验证图像,因此它们与训练集没有共享源图像.

blocks.en: Curation. An edit does not always produce a valid anomaly. We therefore inspected the edited images with the help of a VLM and human verification, and kept only valid logical anomalies. Anomaly types with too few valid images are not used as classes ( A ); N c N_{c} denotes the number of types that remain. Table 1 lists the resulting data, and Fig. 3 shows examples.

All five synthetic anomalies passed curation and are in the final training data. The synthetic anomalies are generated by the image editor (Gemini 3 Pro Image), a generative AI model.

blocks.en: 3.3 Discovering Sub-Modes of Normal Images
blocks.zh: 3.3 发现正常图像的子模式

blocks.en: The normal images of a category are not always homogeneous and may form several distinct sub-modes. The normal training images of Juice Bottle, for instance, show three distinct products: cherry, orange and banana juice, each with its matching fruit icon. If these products share a single normal class, the classifier may learn each icon and each juice color as normal in isolation and fail to detect an incorrect combination, which is precisely a logical anomaly. Each sub-mode is therefore assigned its own normal class.
blocks.zh: 一个类别的正常图像并不总是同质的,可能形成若干不同的子模型. 例如,Juice Bottle的正常训练图像显示三种不同的产品:樱桃、橙汁和香蕉汁,每种产品都有相应的水果图标。 如果这些产品共用一个普通类,分类者可能会在隔离中将每个图标和每个果汁颜色作为正常学习,并未能检测出一个不正确的组合,这恰恰是一个逻辑异常. 每个子模式因此被分配到自己的正常等级.

blocks.en: The sub-modes are identified automatically from the normal training images alone. Features are extracted with the pretrained backbone of the classifier (ConvNeXt-L with DINOv3 weights) before any fine-tuning and clustered with a Gaussian mixture model. The number of clusters K K is proposed by cross-validated likelihood, and the resulting partition is accepted only if the clusters are well separated, none of them is small and they are stable under resampling; otherwise, the next smaller K K is tested, down to a single normal class. Each normal training image takes its cluster as a pseudo-label, fixed before training, and the classifier is then trained with these labels and the anomaly types by standard cross-entropy. Each validation image is assigned the pseudo-label of its most likely cluster. E lists the thresholds.
blocks.zh: 单从普通的训练图像自动识别出分模. 地物在经过任何微调并用高斯混合模型组合之前,先用分级器的预受训练骨干(ConvNEXt-L有DINOv3重量)取出. 集群KK的数量由交叉验证的可能性提出,所形成的分区只有在集群分离良好,无一小并稳定在再生下的情况下才被接受;否则,下一个较小的KK进行测试,降为单一的普通类. 每个普通的训练图像都取其集群为伪标签,在训练前被固定,然后分类器通过标准交叉切入来被训练出这些标签和异常类型. 每个验证图像都被指定为其最可能的集群的伪标签. E列出了阈值.

blocks.en: The procedure splits Juice Bottle into K = 4 K=4 classes, which follow the three fruit types with the banana images in two clusters, and Splicing Connectors into K = 3 K=3 , one per connector type; the other categories keep one normal class (Table 1 ). The two banana clusters are not a distinct product, but both are normal classes, so the extra split does not change which images count as normal. The idea itself is not new: splitting data into pseudo-classes or subclasses by clustering is well established ( Ionescu et al., 2019 ; Cohen et al., 2022 ; Sohoni et al., 2020 ; Liao et al., 2026 ) , and LogSAD ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) samples the normal images that it gives to GPT-4V from the known normal sub-classes of each MVTec LOCO category. We adapt the idea to logical anomaly detection with synthetic anomalies.
blocks.zh: 该程序将Juice瓶分为K=4K=4等,它们跟随三个果型,并用香蕉图像分出两个组;将接通器分出K=3K=3等,每个接通器类型各一个;其他类别则保留一个普通类(表1). 两个香蕉集群并不是一个不同的产品,但两者都是普通类,所以额外的分块不会改变哪些图像算作正常. 这个想法本身并不新鲜:通过分组将数据分解为伪类或子类是公认的(Ionescu等,2019;Cohen等,2022;Sohoni等,2020;Liao等,2026;LogSAD(张等,2025a)从MVTec LOCO各类已知的普通子类中取出给GPT-4V的正常图像. 我们把这个想法适应逻辑异常的检测 与合成异常。

blocks.en: 3.4 Classification Model and Training Procedure
blocks.zh: 3.4 分类模式和培训程序

It is fine-tuned end to end with cross-entropy on the normal images, labeled with their pseudo-labels, and on the synthetic anomalies, labeled by anomaly type. blocks.en: Training. We fine-tune the classifier for 30 epochs at 448 × 448 448\times 448 pixels with AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) ; Table 1 lists all settings. We keep the checkpoint with the lowest cross-entropy on the validation split, which holds the real validation normals with their pseudo-labels and the curated synthetic validation anomalies. This validation-loss checkpoint uses no test image or label. We do not select by validation AUROC, because it saturates at 100% early in training and then no longer distinguishes between checkpoints.
blocks.zh: 培训。 我们用 AdamW (Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019) 微调了 30 个纪元的分类器 ; 表 1 列出了所有设置 。 我们保留着在验证分拆上跨度最低的检查站,它持有真实的验证常态及其伪标签和被整理的合成验证异常. 这个验证-损失检查点没有使用测试图像或标签. 我们不通过验证来选择AUROC,因为它在训练初期饱和度为100%,然后不再区分检查站.

blocks.en: 3.5 Training Augmentation
blocks.zh: 3.5 培训强化

blocks.en: Because some standard augmentation operations resemble the test perturbations, we train two variants of the classifier. The first variant, the full recipe, passes normal images and synthetic anomalies through the same random augmentation pipeline ( Buslaev et al., 2020 ) : flips and 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} rotations, zoom-out with edge-replicated borders, blur, noise and compression, a photometric block (brightness and contrast, contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalization (CLAHE), tone curve, sharpening), and emboss or posterize (Table 2 ). Its zoom-out and brightness change cover the same ranges as the two test perturbations (Section 3.6 ). The second variant, trained without test-overlapping augmentations, omits the zoom-out and photometric blocks and is otherwise identical; Cao et al. (2023) likewise exclude augmentations that overlap their test corruptions. Since neither test perturbation occurs in its training data, our robustness conclusions are based on this variant. Generic augmentations such as blur and noise remain and may contribute to the robustness (Section 5.1 ). The full recipe gives the higher clean AUROC, but its robustness could come from its overlap with the test perturbations.
blocks.zh: 因为一些标准的增强操作类似于测试扰动,所以我们训练了分类器的两个变体. 第一种变体,即完整的食谱,通过相同的随机增强管道(Buslaev等,2020年)传递出正常的图像和合成异常:翻转和90 ∘ 90 ^{\circ}旋转,用边缘复制边框放大,模糊,噪音和压缩,一个光度测量块(亮度和对比度,对比度受限的适应直径平分(CLAHE),声调曲线,磨合),以及外观或外观(表2). 它的放大和亮度变化与两次试验扰动的幅度相同(第3.6节)。 第二种变体未经试验重叠增强而训练,省略了缩放和光度测量块,否则是相同的;Cao等人。 (2023年)同样排除了与其检验腐败重叠的加价。 由于其培训数据中既不发生测试扰动,因此我们的稳健性结论基于这一变体. 模糊和噪音等一般性的增强仍然存在,并可能助长强度(第5.1节)。 完整的食谱使AUROC更加干净,但其坚固性可能来自于它与测试扰动的重叠.

blocks.en: 3.6 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.6 评价议定书

blocks.en: Perturbations. Robustness is measured on test images with simulated capture shifts. We apply six perturbations from two families to the full-resolution test images, before any preprocessing of the evaluated method (Fig. 4 ). Brightness reduction multiplies all pixel values by 0.8, 0.6 or 0.4. Zoom-out shrinks the image by 5%, 10% or 15% and pads it back to its original size with edge-replicated borders, so every object stays in view. Together with the unperturbed (clean) condition, the six perturbations define seven test conditions, denoted Clean, B20, B40 and B60 for brightness reduction, and Z5, Z10 and Z15 for zoom-out.
blocks.zh: 烦恼. 在测试图像上用模拟的捕获移来测量强度. 在对评估方法进行任何预处理之前,我们将两个家庭的6个扰动用于全分辨率测试图像(图4)。 亮度还原将所有像素值相乘以0.8,0.6或0.4. 缩放缩小了图像的5%,10%或15%,并用边缘复制的边框将图像放回原来的大小,因此每个物体都留在视野中. 6个扰动与未扰动(clean)条件一起,定义了7个测试条件,表示Clean,B20,B40和B60为亮度还原,Z5,Z10和Z15为缩放.

blocks.en: We chose these two families because they are typical uncontrolled capture shifts on an inspection line, due to changes in illumination and camera placement ( Baitieva et al., 2025 ) ; because they act on the whole image without changing its logical content; and because their severity can be graded. We reduce rather than increase brightness because an increase clips bright regions to uniform white, which can erase parts and boundaries and thus alter the logical content of the image; a reduction preserves all parts, at the cost of coarser quantization in dark regions. Likewise, we zoom out rather than in, because zooming in would crop parts at the border and could itself create an anomaly. Other perturbation families and real capture shifts are left for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们之所以选择这两个家庭,是因为他们在检查线上是典型的不受控制的捕捉转移,这是由于照明和相机布置的变化(Baitieva等,2025年);因为他们在不改变其逻辑内容的情况下对整个图像采取行动;以及因为他们的严重性可以被分级. 我们减少而不是增加亮度,因为增加片段会使亮度区域变为统一的白色,这样可以去除部分和边界,从而改变图像的逻辑内容;减少片段会保存出所有部分,而牺牲了在黑暗区域的相近量化. 同样,我们放大而不是放大,因为放大就会在边界上造成部分损失,本身就可能造成异常。 其他扰动家庭和真正的抓捕轮回留给未来工作。

blocks.en: Heterogeneous perturbation protocol. A deployed detector usually compares every score with the same threshold, whatever the condition of the image. In the heterogeneous perturbation protocol, each test image therefore independently receives one of the seven conditions with equal probability, and one AUROC is computed over the mixed test set; Baitieva et al. (2025) applied a similar random drift, drawn per test image, to real industrial datasets, and the mixed test split of MVTec AD 2, a benchmark of mainly structural defects, likewise draws the lighting of each test image at random ( Heckler-Kram et al., 2026 ) . We repeat the random assignment 100 times, use the same assignments for every method, and report the mean as the heterogeneous AUROC.
blocks.zh: 异相相扰动协议. 部署的探测器通常将每个分数与相同的阈值进行比较,无论图像的条件如何. 因此,在各种扰动协议中,每个测试图像都独立地获得一个相同概率的7个条件,一个AUROC是通过混合测试集计算出来的;Baitieva等人(2025年)对真实的工业数据集采用了类似的随机漂移,按测试图像抽取,MVTec AD2的混合测试分拆也是主要结构缺陷的基准,同样随机抽取每个测试图像的照明(Heckler-Kram等人,2026年)。 我们重复随机任务100次,对每一种方法都使用相同的任务,并报告平均值为各种AUROC。

blocks.zh: 4 实验评价.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We use all five categories (Breakfast Box, Juice Bottle, Pushpins, Screw Bag and Splicing Connectors) of MVTec LOCO AD ( Bergmann et al., 2022 ) with the standard splits. Training and validation use real normal (good) images and synthetic anomalies. The test set contains only real images: normal images and logical anomalies; we leave the structural anomalies out. Table 1 gives the image counts.
blocks.zh: 我们使用MVTec LOCO AD(Bergmann等,2022年)的所有五个类别(Breakfast Box,Juice Bottle, Pushpins, Screw Bag and Splicing Connectors),标准分出. 训练和验证使用真实的正常(好)图像和合成异常. 测试集只包含真实的图像:正常的图像和逻辑异常;我们把结构异常留出. 表1列出图像数。

blocks.en: The classifier follows the recipe and checkpoint selection of Section 3.4 , in two versions (Section 3.5 ): Ours (no overlap), without test-overlapping augmentations (no zoom-out or brightness augmentation in training), and Ours (full recipe).
blocks.zh: 分类人员遵循第3.4节的食谱和检查站选择,分为两个版本(第3.5节): 我们的(没有重叠),没有试验重叠的增强(在训练中没有放大或亮度增强)和我们的(完全的食谱)。

blocks.en: We compare with four normal-reference methods, CSAD ( Hsieh and Lai, 2024 ) , SALAD ( Fučka et al., 2025 ) , LogSAD ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) and PatchCore ( Roth et al., 2022 ) , and with AnomalyCLIP ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , a zero-shot method that uses no normal reference. All baselines use the official code and released weights without training any network, and each keeps the same model for all seven test conditions; for CSAD, SALAD and LogSAD, our clean measurements are within one point of the reported values. SALAD scores a composition map of each test image; because the trained model that produces these maps is not released, we use the maps that SALAD’s authors released for the clean test images, so these maps are unaffected by the perturbation, which favors SALAD. D gives the settings.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了四种正常参考方法:旱研中心(Hsieh和Lai,2024年),SALAD(Fučka等,2025年),LogSAD。 (Zhang等,2025a)和PatchCore(Roth等,2022年),以及AnomalyCLIP (周等,2024年),一种零射入法,不使用正常参考. 所有基准都使用官方代码并释放出权重而不培训任何网络,每个基准都对所有七个测试条件保持相同的模型;对于CSAD,SALAD和LogSAD,我们的清洁测量值在所报值的一分之内. SALAD对每个测试图像的构成图进行分数;因为制作这些地图的训练有素的模型没有被放出,所以我们使用SALAD的作者为清洁测试图像发布的地图,所以这些地图不受扰动的影响,这有利于SALAD. D给设置。

blocks.en: We report image-level AUROC on the logical anomalies, in percent and averaged over the five categories, together with the drop and the relative drop (Section 3.6 ).
blocks.zh: 我们报告图像级AUROC的逻辑异常情况,以百分比计,并按五个类别以及下降和相对下降(第3.6节)。

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 2 : Main results. Clean and heterogeneous image-level logical AUROC (%), mean over the five categories.
blocks.zh: 表2:主要结果。 清洁和多相图像级逻辑 AUROC (%), 指五类之上.

blocks.en: We first quantify the performance degradation of existing methods under capture shifts (Table 2 , Fig. 1 ). Under the heterogeneous perturbation protocol, the normal-reference methods we tested lose 9.7 to 34.1 points, a relative drop of 38.2% to 73.5%. Notably, among these methods, the two with the highest clean AUROC exhibit the largest degradation: CSAD drops from 97.7% to 68.1% and SALAD from 96.4% to 62.3%. AnomalyCLIP, near chance, loses only 3.0 points, which is still a relative drop of 41.1%. AnomalyCLIP’s low clean AUROC agrees with a related zero-shot evaluation on MVTec LOCO, in which AnomalyCLIP, AdaCLIP and WinCLIP reach 61.6%, 60.9% and 53.2% image-level AUROC, not reported separately for logical anomalies ( Fučka et al., 2026b ) . The order also changes: LogSAD moves ahead of CSAD and SALAD, so in our comparison clean AUROC does not predict the ranking under capture shifts.
blocks.zh: 我们首先量化捕获变化中现有方法的性能退化(表2,图1)。 根据各种扰动协议,我们测试的正常参考方法损失了9.7至34.1分,相对下降38.2%至73.5%。 值得注意的是,在这些方法中,清洁度最高的两种方法的降解幅度最大:旱研中心从97.7%降至68.1%;SALAD从96.4%降至62.3%。 AnomalyCLIP,近乎偶然,只损失了3.0分,仍相对下降41.1%. AnomalyCLIP低清的AUROC同意MVTec LOCO的相关零发评价,其中AnomalyCLIP,AdaCLIP和WinCLIP达到61.6%,60.9%和53.2%的图像级AUROC,没有针对逻辑异常单独报告(Fučka等,2026b.). 命令也改变: LogSAD在CSAD和SALAD之前移动,因此在我们的比较中,干净的AUROC并不预测捕获分班的排名.

blocks.en: In contrast, our framework is largely unaffected: AUROC decreases by 0.7 points for Ours (no overlap), from 93.2% to 92.5%, and by 0.8 points for Ours (full recipe), from 94.9% to 94.1%, corresponding to relative drops of 1.6% and 1.8%. The same holds in every category (Table 1 ): the heterogeneous AUROC of our framework stays within 2.4 points of its clean value, while CSAD and SALAD lose 12.6 to 41.3 points. As explained in Section 3.5 , the robustness claim rests on Ours (no overlap).
blocks.zh: 相反,我们的框架基本上没有受到影响:AUROC从93.2%下降到92.5%,从94.9%下降到94.1%,相对下降1.6%和1.8%。 每一类情况也是如此(表1):我们框架的不同AUROC保持在其净值的2.4分以内,而CSAD和SALAD则损失了12.6至41.3分。 正如第3.5节所解释的,稳健性要求取决于我们的(没有重叠)。

blocks.en: On clean images, however, Ours (full recipe) is 1.5 to 2.8 points below SALAD and CSAD, and below the three methods in the bottom block of Table 2 , SALAD † ( Fučka et al., 2025 ) , PSAD ( Kim et al., 2024 ) and SAM-LAD ( Peng et al., 2025 ) , whose robustness we could not measure ( D ). The gap to SALAD and CSAD comes mainly from Screw Bag and Splicing Connectors (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 然而,在干净的图像上,我们的(完整的食谱)低于SALAD和CSAD的1.5至2.8分,低于表2下方的三种方法,即SALAD(Fučka等,2025年),PSAD(Kim等,2024年)和SAM-LAD(Peng等,2025年),我们无法衡量它们的稳健性(D)。 与SALAD和CSAD的缺口主要出自"螺旋袋"和"螺旋相接"(表1).

blocks.en: 4.3 Robustness Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 强性分析

blocks.en: A performance drop shows how much a method degrades, but not why. Under reduced brightness, degradation can arise in two distinct ways, each requiring a different remedy. First, the method may no longer distinguish darkened anomalies from darkened normal images, even when evaluated only on darkened images (a within-condition drop). Second, it may preserve this ranking within darkened images, but shift all scores upward. In that case, a darkened normal image may receive a higher score than a clean anomaly, preventing a single threshold from separating the mixed test set despite good within-condition ranking (a cross-condition drop). Per-condition AUROC (Table 3 ; Section 3.6 ) distinguishes these effects: its difference from clean AUROC quantifies the within-condition drop, whereas its difference from heterogeneous AUROC quantifies the cross-condition drop.
blocks.zh: 性能下降表明一种方法可降解多少,但不是为什么。 在亮度降低的情况下,退化可能以两种不同的方式出现,每种方式都需要不同的补救. 首先,该方法可能不再区分被暗化的异常和被暗化的正常图像,即使只在被暗化的图像上评价(在条件内下降). 第二,它可能在被暗化的图像中保持这个排名,但将所有分数向上移. 在这种情况下,一个被暗化的正常图像可能会得到比干净的异常值更高的分数,使得一个单一阈值尽管条件范围内的排名良好(交叉条件的下降),却无法分离出混合测试集. 有条件的AUROC(表3;第3.6节)区分了这些影响:它与干净的AUROC的区别将条件内下降量化,而它与多样性的AUROC的区别则将条件内下降量化。

Per-condition: the mean AUROC of the six perturbed conditions, each scored on its own (Table 1 gives each condition). blocks.en: CSAD and SALAD fail in these two ways. Most of the drop of CSAD is within-condition drop (22.7 of 29.6 points): CSAD separates normal from anomalous images worse even within one condition. Most of the drop of SALAD is cross-condition drop (23.3 of 34.1 points): SALAD’s scores move with the condition. For our framework, however, both parts stay below one point.
blocks.zh: CSAD和SALAD在这两个方面都失败了. 旱研中心降下的大部分是有条件的降下(29.6分中22.7分): 旱研中心将正常图像与异常图像区分开来,即使在一个条件下,情况也更糟。 SALAD的倒下大部分是交叉条件倒下(34.1分中的23.3分): SALAD的分数随情况而变化. 然而,对我们的框架来说,两部分都低于一点。

blocks.en: The difference matters: only the cross-condition drop could be repaired by per-condition recalibration. Such a recalibration keeps the order of the scores within each condition, so it cannot change the per-condition AUROC, which stays at 75.0%, 85.6% and 77.5% for CSAD, SALAD and LogSAD, below our 92.8% and 94.1%. Our worst condition, the 15% zoom-out (91.0% and 93.0%), is also above the worst condition of every baseline.
blocks.zh: 区别很重要:只有交叉条件的倒放才能通过条件调整来修复. 这种重新校正使每个条件的分数顺序保持不变,因此无法改变AUROC的附加条件,CSAD、SALAD和LOGSAD的分数保持在75.0%、85.6%和77.5%,低于92.8%和94.1%。 我们最糟糕的状况,即15%的缩放(91.0%和93.0%)也高于每个基线的最差状况。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Normal images scoring above the median clean anomaly. Each cell gives the share of normal (good) test images whose anomaly score is higher than the median score of the clean anomalous test images, as a five-category mean (%). The clean column is the starting point: a detector that separates clean images well starts near 0%, while PatchCore, which separates them less well, already starts at 12%. A detector whose normal scores do not move with the capture conditions keeps its clean value in every column; a rise means that a brightness reduction or a zoom-out alone moves normal images above the median clean anomaly. AnomalyCLIP is left out: near chance on clean images, it already scores 38% of its normal images above its median clean anomaly.
blocks.zh: 图5:正常图像积分高于中位数清洁异常. 每个细胞给出正常(好)测试图像的分数,其异常分数高于清洁异常测试图像的中位分数,作为五类平均值(%). 清洁柱是起点:一个将清洁图像井分离的探测器开始于接近0%,而PatchCore将它们分离得不太好,已经开始于12%. 正常分数不随捕捉条件而移动的探测器将它的清洁值保存在每个列上;上升意味着亮度降低或被放大后单独移动到正常图像高于中位清洁异常. AnomalyCLIP被忽略了:在干净的图像上,它已经将其正常图像的38%的分数超过其中位干净的异常.

blocks.en: Fig. 5 shows how far the scores move with the condition: at the stronger settings, every normal-reference method we tested scores many normal test images above the median clean anomaly, while the classifier keeps almost all of them below it. Section 5.1 discusses possible causes of this difference.
blocks.zh: 图5显示了分数随条件移动的多远:在更强的设置下,我们测试的每一种正常参考方法都会在中位净异常值上分出许多正常的测试图像,而分级器则将几乎所有的分数都保持在下. 第5.1节讨论了造成这种差异的可能原因。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 读取研究

blocks.en: Table 4 : Ablation. Image-level logical AUROC (%), mean over the five categories; each row below the first removes one component from the full recipe.
blocks.zh: 表4:缺损。 图像级逻辑 AUROC (%),指五类之上;第一行下方的每行从全食谱中去掉一个组件.

blocks.en: Table 4 removes one component at a time from the full recipe. Normal sub-mode discovery adds 2.0 points on clean images and 2.4 under the heterogeneous perturbation protocol, and changes only Juice Bottle and Splicing Connectors, the two categories that it splits (Section 3.3 ; per category in E ). Because this comparison keeps the full augmentation, we interpret it as a gain in accuracy, not as evidence of robustness. The test-overlapping augmentations add 1.7 points on clean images and 1.6 under the heterogeneous perturbation protocol; without them, as in Ours (no overlap), our framework is less accurate but still robust.
blocks.zh: 表4从完整的食谱中删除一个成分。 普通子模式的发现在清洁图像上增加了2.0分,在多变的扰动协议下增加了2.4分,并且只改变汁瓶和螺旋连接器,即它分裂的两类(第3.3节;E类中的每类. 因为这种比较保持了完全的增强,所以我们把它解释为精度的提高,而不是强健性的证据. 测试重叠增强在干净的图像上增加了1.7分,在各种扰动协议下增加了1.6分;没有这些,如《我们的》中(没有重叠),我们的框架不太准确,但仍很健全。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Source of Robustness
blocks.zh: 5.1 强力的来源

blocks.en: This section discusses possible reasons why the normal-reference methods we tested degrade substantially under the heterogeneous perturbation protocol, whereas our framework is largely unaffected (Section 4.2 ). Normal-reference detectors compare test images with normal data captured under a single lighting condition and camera position. We hypothesize that, as a result, reduced brightness or zooming out may increase the anomaly score of a defect-free product, making it difficult to distinguish a logical anomaly from a capture-related shift. Out-of-distribution detection makes a similar distinction between semantic shifts and covariate shifts, which change appearance without altering semantic content ( Yang et al., 2023 ) . In these terms, a logical anomaly corresponds to a semantic shift and a capture shift to a covariate shift.
blocks.zh: 本节讨论我们试验的正常参考方法在各种扰动协议下大量降解的可能原因,而我们的框架基本上没有受到影响(第4.2节)。 普通参考探测器将测试图像与在单一照明条件和相机位置下捕获的正常数据进行比较. 我们假设,因此,降低亮度或放大可能会增加无缺陷产品的异常分数,从而难以区分逻辑异常与捕捉相关的转变. 分布外检测对语义变换和相变变变换作了相近的区分,这些变换会改变外观而不会改变语义内容(杨等,2023. 在这些术语中,逻辑异常对应的是语义变换和捕捉变换为共变变换.

blocks.en: Evidence. Fig. 5 supports this hypothesis: at the strongest settings, CSAD and SALAD score most normal test images above the median clean anomaly. A fully discriminative decision behaves differently: Ours (no overlap) retains its AUROC although neither perturbation occurs in its training, almost none of its normal test images score above the median clean anomaly (Fig. 5 ), and both parts of its drop are close to zero (Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh: 证相. 图5支持这一假说:在最强的设置中,CSAD和SALAD得分最高的普通测试图像高于中位净异常. 完全歧视性的决定行为不同: 我们的AUROC(没有重叠)保留了它的AUROC,尽管它的训练中既不发生扰动,其正常的测试图像几乎无一得分高于中位干净异常(图5),其下降的两个部分都接近于零(第4.3节.

blocks.en: Candidate explanations. These observations show that our decision is robust, but do not explain why. One possibility is that the score is relative: it weighs evidence for normal classes against evidence for anomaly types learned from images captured under the same conditions. In contrast, a distance-to-normal score may increase with any appearance change. Remaining training augmentations, such as blur and noise, may also contribute.
blocks.zh: 候选人解释。 这些意见表明,我们的决定是有力的,但不能解释原因。 一种可能性是分数是相对的:它将正常类的证据与从同样条件下捕获的图像中吸取的异常类型的证据相权衡. 相形之下,距离与正常的分数可能会随着外观的变化而增加. 诸如模糊不清和噪音等其余的强化培训也可能有所帮助。

blocks.en: Two failure modes. The two failure modes described in Section 4.3 have different practical implications. When performance loss is primarily a cross-condition drop, as for SALAD, the method largely preserves its ranking within each condition. The main issue is that a single decision threshold no longer works across conditions. This can be addressed outside the detector by monitoring lighting and camera placement and applying condition-specific thresholds.
blocks.zh: 两种失败模式。 第4.3节所描述的两种失败模式具有不同的实际影响。 当性能损失主要是交叉条件的下降时,如同SALAD一样,这种方法在很大程度上保持了在每个条件下的排名. 主要问题是,单一决定门槛不再在条件上起作用。 这可以通过监测照明和相机布置以及应用特定条件的阈值,在探测器外解决.

blocks.en: When the loss is primarily a within-condition drop, as for CSAD, condition-specific thresholds cannot restore performance (Section 4.3 ). In this case, the practical safeguard is to maintain capture conditions as closely as possible to those used in training.
blocks.zh: 如果损失主要是在条件范围内的下降,则与旱研中心一样,特定条件的阈值无法恢复性能(第4.3节)。 在这种情况下,实际的保障措施是尽可能保持与培训中使用的条件相接近的捕捉条件。

blocks.en: Test-time adaptation. Both safeguards operate outside a trained detector; test-time adaptation (Section 2.3 ) instead adapts to the test images and could be applied to our framework as well. Our results address a prior question: whether the decision itself is robust without adaptation.
blocks.zh: 试验时间适应. 这两种保障措施都在训练有素的探测器之外运作;试验时间的调整(第2.3节)适应试验图像,也可以适用于我们的框架。 我们的成果涉及一个先前的问题:该决定本身是否有力而无需调整。

blocks.en: 5.2 Limitations and Open Questions
blocks.zh: 5.2 限制和开放问题

blocks.en: Clean AUROC. On clean images, the full recipe is 1.5 to 2.8 points below SALAD and CSAD (Section 4.2 ). On a line where capture is held as tightly as in training, a normal-reference method may therefore be the better choice.
blocks.zh: 干净的AUROC。 在清洁图像方面,完整的食谱低于SALAD和CSAD(第4.2节)1.5至2.8分. 因此,在像训练一样紧紧地进行捕获的一行中,一种正常的参考方法可能是更好的选择。

blocks.en: Human input. A person writes the short description of each category, which defines what counts as normal, and checks what is generated from it. Automating both steps is future work.
blocks.zh: 人入入处. 一个人写每个类别的简短描述,定义什么算什么是正常的,并检查它产生的什么. 两个步骤自动化是今后的工作。

blocks.en: Synthetic anomalies. The description also limits the anomaly types available for training: types derived from it cannot guarantee that every real anomaly is covered, and we did not evaluate performance separately on real anomalies of types outside the generated list. Generation artifacts, such as blending seams, could act as shortcuts; because the test set contains only real images, any harm from them is already reflected in the reported AUROC.
blocks.zh: 合成异常. 描述也限制了可供训练的异常类型:它衍生出来的类型无法保证每个真实的异常都被覆盖,我们也没有对生成列表以外的类型的真实异常进行单独评价. 世代相传的文物,如混合接缝,可以作为捷径;因为测试集只包含真实的图像,因此任何来自这些图像的伤害已经反映在所报告的AUROC中.

blocks.en: Scope of the evaluation. Our evaluation is narrower than the setting that motivates it. Our test perturbations are synthetic and come from two families, brightness reduction and zoom-out (Section 3.6 gives the reasons). Real low-light capture also adds sensor noise and uneven illumination, and the object may shift relative to the camera; our perturbations simulate neither. Robustness to wider and real capture shifts remains open.
blocks.zh: 评价的范围。 我们的评价比推动评价的环境要狭窄。 我们的试验扰动是合成的,来自两个家庭,即亮度降低和放大(第3.6节给出了原因)。 真正的低光捕捉也增加了感应噪声和不均匀的发光,物体可能相对于相机而移动;我们的扰动也模拟了两者. 对更广泛和真实的捕捉转变的坚强态度仍然开放。

blocks.en: Closed models. The language model and the image editor are closed models, so the generation stage cannot be repeated exactly; the material we will release is listed in the data availability statement.
blocks.zh: 封闭模型。 语言模型和图像编辑器都是闭合模型,因此生成阶段不能完全重复;我们将发布的材料在数据可用性说明中列出.

blocks.en: Role of the anomaly design. Our results evaluate the framework as a whole and do not isolate the contribution of designing anomalies with a language model. Whether this design outperforms simpler synthesis, such as cut-and-paste anomalies ( Li et al., 2021 ) , remains open and would require a controlled comparison with the rest of the framework unchanged.
blocks.zh: 异常设计的作用. 我们的成果对整个框架进行评价,并不孤立用语言模式设计异常因素的贡献。 这种设计是否超越了更简单的合成,如剪贴异常(Li等,2021年),是否仍然开放,并且需要与框架的其余部分进行有控制的比较,不变.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We showed that the normal-reference detectors are fragile under two simple capture shifts. Under the heterogeneous perturbation protocol, they lose 9.7 to 34.1 AUROC points, 38.2% to 73.5% of their performance above chance. They degrade in two ways: some lose discrimination within a condition, which no per-condition recalibration can repair, and others shift their scores between conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,正常的参照探测器在两个简单的捕获转换下是脆弱的。 根据各种扰动协议,它们损失了9.7至34.1个AUROC分数,占其性能的38.2%至73.5%。 其降解有两种方式:有的在某种条件下丧失了歧视,任何有条件的再校正都无法修复;有的则在条件之间转移分数.

blocks.en: We proposed a framework in which a classifier is trained on normal images and synthetic anomalies generated from brief category descriptions, then scores test images without reference to normal data. Anomaly types derived from a short description of each category are applied to normal images with an instruction-based image editor, and the classifier learns to separate the edited images from automatically discovered normal sub-modes. With its full training recipe, the framework reaches 94.9% AUROC on clean images, 1.5 to 2.8 points below SALAD and CSAD, and 94.1% under the perturbation protocol; trained without brightness or zoom-out augmentation, it loses only 0.7 points (93.2% to 92.5%).
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个框架,对分类员进行关于普通图像和从简单分类描述中产生的合成异常的培训,然后在不参考正常数据的情况下对图像进行分数。 从对每个类别的简短描述中衍生出来的异常类型被应用到以指令为主的图像编辑器的普通图像上,分类器学习将所编辑的图像与自动发现的普通子模型相分离. 有了完整的培训方法,框架在清洁图像上达到94.9%的AUROC,低于SALAD和CSAD1.5至2.8分,在扰动协议下达到94.1%;经过培训,没有亮度或放大增强,只损失了0.7分(93.2%至92.5%)。

blocks.en: These results suggest that clean AUROC alone may not predict how a detector behaves on a production line, and that a change in lighting or camera position alone can cause normal-reference detectors to score defect-free products as anomalous. Our evaluation, however, covers one benchmark and two synthetic shift families, and a person still writes the category description and checks what is generated from it. Future work includes automating these two steps, testing wider and real capture shifts, localizing the detected anomalies and extending the framework to structural anomalies.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,光是清洁的AUROC可能无法预测出一个探测器在生产线上的表现,光线或相机位置的改变本身就会导致正常的参考探测器将无缺陷产品评分为异常. 然而,我们的评估包括一个基准和两个合成的转移家庭,一个人仍然写下分类说明并检查它所产生的内容。 未来的工作包括使这两个步骤自动化,测试更广泛而真实的捕捉转变,将所发现的异常点本地化,将框架扩展到结构异常点.

blocks.en: Dataset Content: A collection of images showing a two-compartment breakfast tray containing food items arranged in a consistent layout. Tray Characteristics 1. The tray is always a white foam tray with two compartments . 2. The left compartment is consistently narrower , and the right compartment is consistently wider . Left Compartment Content (Fixed Set, Variable Order) 1. The left compartment contains exactly three whole fruits in every image: 2 oranges , 1 peach . 2. The fruits are placed in a single vertical column (top-to-bottom, one fruit per position). 3. The order is variable across images (any permutation of two oranges and one peach is allowed). 4. No other items appear in the left compartment. Right Compartment Content (Fixed Regions). The right compartment is consistently divided into two content regions: 1. Upper Region (Cornflakes): Contains only cornflakes . Cornflakes occupy more than half of the right compartment’s area. The cornflakes form a single contiguous, unmixed region (no other items present within this upper area). 2. Lower Region (Mixed Banana and Almonds): Contains a mixture of sliced banana and almonds . Banana slices and almonds are randomly interspersed (no fixed pattern or separation). No other items appear in the lower region.

blocks.en: Dataset Content: The dataset contains images of transparent bottles filled with juice. Bottle Characteristics 1. All bottles are transparent and filled with juice. 2. blocks.en: Dataset Content: A collection of images showing electrical cable splicing connectors placed on a metal grid background . Scene Structure (Fixed Counts). Each image contains exactly (no more, no less): 1. 2 splicing connectors (no more, no less; one on the left , one on the right ) 2. 1 cable connecting the two connectors (no more, no less) Connector Types and Cable Color Mapping. Connectors can be one of the following types (defined by the number of ports/levers ): 1. T2: 2-port connector (small, 2 levers ) → \rightarrow Yellow cable 2. T3: 3-port connector (medium, 3 levers ) → \rightarrow Blue cable 3. T5: 5-port connector (large, 5 levers ) → \rightarrow Red cable Consistency Rules (Invariant Across All Normal Samples) 1. The two connectors in the same image must be the same type (both T2, both T3, or both T5). 2. The cable color is strictly determined by connector type (T2=yellow, T3=blue, T5=red), with no exceptions . Only these 3 colors exist in normal samples; cables of other colors never appear. 3. The cable must be inserted into both connectors (i.e., physically connected on both ends). 4. The cable must be connected to the same lever index/row on both connectors (the specific lever used may vary between images, but must match left-to-right). 5. All connector levers must be closed . 6. The connectors must be upright and aligned , facing each other in a straight configuration. 7. The cable length must remain within a standard expected range (not excessively short or long). 8. The cable must be intact and continuous (not broken or cut). Allowed Variations 1. The positions , spacing , orientation , and viewpoint of the connectors and cable may vary between images, as long as all rules above remain satisfied.

blocks.en: Appendix D Baseline setups
blocks.zh: 附录D 基线设置

blocks.en: This appendix lists the settings of each baseline, so that the robustness comparison can be repeated. All baselines use the official code and released weights without training any network (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: 本附录列出每个基准的设置,以便可以重复强性比较. 所有基线都使用官方代码,并释放出重量而不培训任何网络(第4节)。

blocks.en: Official code of CSAD ( https://github.com/Tokichan/CSAD ; Hsieh and Lai, 2024 ) and SALAD ( https://github.com/MaticFuc/SALAD ; Fučka et al., 2025 ) with the weights released by the authors, in their default settings.
blocks.zh: CSAD的官方代码(https://github.com/tokichan/CSAD;Hsieh和Lai,2024年)和SALAD(https://github.com/MaticFuc/SALAD;Fučka等,2025年),作者在其默认情况下释放出重量.

blocks.en: Official code of LogSAD ( https://github.com/zhang0jhon/LogSAD ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) in its full-data setting, with its frozen foundation models at 448 × 448 448\times 448 . We score each image by the larger of LogSAD’s two scores before its final sigmoid, keeping rule-flagged images on top, because the float64 sigmoid saturates at exactly 1.0 for large values and creates ties; where it does not saturate, the ranking and the AUROC are unchanged.
blocks.zh: LogSAD的官方代码(https://github.com/zhang0jhon/LogSAD;张等,2025a.)在其全数据设置中,其被冻结的地基模型为448×448\448\times 448. 在LogSAD最后的 sigmoid 之前, 我们用更大的 2 个分数来评分每个图像, 将标有规则的图像保留在上方, 因为浮点64 的 sigmoid 饱和度完全为 1.0 值, 并创建了链接; 如果它不饱和, 排名和 AUROC 不变 。

blocks.en: Official code of PatchCore ( https://github.com/amazon-science/patchcore-inspection ; Roth et al., 2022 ) with an ImageNet WideResNet-50-2, layer2 and layer3 features aggregated over 3 × 3 3\times 3 neighborhoods and pooled to 1024 dimensions, a 10% greedy coreset of the clean training patches, and the largest nearest-neighbor patch distance as the image score. We resize the whole image to 256 × 256 256\times 256 instead of using the default center crop, which would cut off the ends of the non-square LOCO images.
blocks.zh: PatchCore的官方代码(https://github.com/amazon-science/patchcore-invision;Roth等,2022年),其ImageNet WideResNet-50-2,地层2和地层3等地功能聚集了3×3个地层并集合到1024个维度,是清真训练补丁的10%贪心核心集,也是作为图像分数的最大近邻补丁相距. 我们把整个图像调整为256×256 256\times 256,而不是使用默认的中心收成,这将切断非平方 LOCO 图像的端口.

blocks.en: Official code of AnomalyCLIP ( https://github.com/zqhang/AnomalyCLIP ; Zhou et al., 2024 ), run zero-shot with OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14@336 and the prompt checkpoint the authors trained on VisA, at 518 × 518 518\times 518 . The image score is the probability of the anomaly prompt; no LOCO image is used as a normal reference.
blocks.zh: AnomalyCLIP的官方代码(https://github.com/zqhang/AnomalyCLIP;周克等,2024年),以OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14@336和在VisA上训练的作者的即时检查站运行于518×518 518\times 518. 图像分数是异常提示的概率;没有LOCO图像作为正常的参考.

blocks.en: SALAD † ( Fučka et al., 2025 ) , the setting of SALAD trained with the supervised part maps of PSAD, would need training; PSAD ( Kim et al., 2024 ) has no released MVTec LOCO weights and needs training with hand-labeled part masks; SAM-LAD ( Peng et al., 2025 ) has no official implementation. We therefore report their published clean AUROC and could not measure their robustness.
blocks.zh: SALAD †(Fučka等,2025年),SALAD的设置用PSAD的受监督部分地图进行训练,需要培训;PSAD(Kim等,2024年)没有发布MVTec LOCO重量并需要使用手贴标签的部分口罩培训;SAM-LAD(Peng等,2025年)没有正式实施. 因此,我们报告他们发表的干净的AUROC,无法衡量他们的稳健性。

blocks.en: Appendix E Discovering sub-modes of normal images
blocks.zh: 附录 E 发现普通图像的子模式

blocks.en: Table 1 : Normal sub-mode discovery per category. Only normal training images are used. The candidate K K is chosen by 5-fold cross-validated log-likelihood with the one-standard-error rule; a candidate must pass three gates (silhouette ≥ 0.25 \geq 0.25 , smallest cluster ≥ 10 % \geq 10\% , median bootstrap ARI ≥ 0.8 \geq 0.8 ), otherwise K − 1 K-1 is tried.
blocks.zh: 表1:每个类别正常的子模式发现. 只使用普通的训练图像. K K 候选人由5倍的交叉验证的对数比对单标准-错误规则进行选择;候选人必须经过3个门(silhouette ^ 0.25\geq 0.25,最小的集群 → 10%\geq 10\,中位靴 ARI → 0.8\geq 0.8),否则K − 1 K 1 尝试.

blocks.en: This appendix gives the exact rule of normal sub-mode discovery (Section 3.3 ). It runs once per category before training and uses only the normal training images. The features are the pooled output of the frozen, pretrained ConvNeXt-L DINOv3 backbone at 448 × 448 448\times 448 , normalized to unit length and reduced to eight dimensions by principal component analysis (PCA). Gaussian mixtures with a tied covariance are fitted for K = 1 , … , 5 K=1,\dots,5 , and the candidate is the smallest K K within one standard error of the best 5-fold cross-validated log-likelihood ( Hastie et al., 2009 ) . A candidate K > 1 K>1 must pass the three gates of Table 1 , where the silhouette ( Rousseeuw, 1987 ) is computed on the fitted clusters and the adjusted Rand index (ARI; Hubert and Arabie, 1985 ) against 20 refits on bootstrap samples; otherwise K − 1 , K − 2 , … K-1,K-2,\dots are tried, down to K = 1 K=1 . Finally, validation normal images are assigned to sub-modes by the mixture fitted on the training images.
blocks.zh: 本附录给出了正常子模式发现的确切规则(第3.3节. 它在训练前每类运行一次,只使用正常的训练画面. 其特征是被冻结的ConvNEXt-L DINOv3主干线在448×448\times 448的集成输出,通过主组件分析(PCA)实现单位长度常态化并缩小为8个维. 具有捆绑共变的高斯混合物被装入K = 1,.,5 K = 1,\dots,5, 候选者是最佳5倍交叉验证日志相通标准误差中最小的K K (Hastie等,2009年). 一名候选人K > 1 K>1必须经过表1的3个门口,即根据装配的星团和经调整的Rand指数(ARI;Hubert和Arabie,1985年)来计算;否则K−1、K−2、.K-1、K-2、\dots将尝试,降为K=1K=1。 最后,校验正常的图像被安装在训练图像上的混合物分配给分模。

blocks.en: Under this rule, in Juice Bottle, the banana juice images form two of the four clusters (75 and 37 images); in Splicing Connectors, each of the three clusters holds 120 images. Over 45 combinations of the gate thresholds (silhouette 0.15–0.35, smallest cluster 5–15%, ARI 0.7–0.9), the same two categories are split; only the number of sub-modes varies.
blocks.zh: 根据这一规则,在"Juice Bottle"中,香蕉汁相片组成了四个集群中的两个(75和37相片);在"Splicing Connectors"中,三个集群中各自持有120相片. 门阈值超过45个组合(silhouette 0.15–0.35,最小的组数为5–15%,ARI 0.7–0.9),相同的两类被拆分;只有子模数不同.

blocks.en: With a single normal class instead of these sub-modes, the clean AUROC falls from 97.0% to 92.2% in Juice Bottle and from 90.3% to 84.9% in Splicing Connectors; the other categories are unchanged by construction.
blocks.zh: 清洁的AUROC在Juice瓶中从97.0%下降到92.2%,在Splicing Connectors中从90.3%下降到84.9%;其他类别则按构造变化不变.
